rules.condition: FIFO in Empty state (after reset or all words read)
rules.statement: While empty, o_empty must be 1 and reads must be rejected; a read request produces o_underflow.

rules.condition: FIFO in Full state (all entries used, write view)
rules.statement: While full, o_full must be 1 and writes must be rejected; a write request produces o_overflow.
In the Partial state, reads and writes must both be accepted.

rules.condition: i_rst_n_sw = 0 with the write FSM in RUN
rules.statement: Software reset must block both interfaces, set o_empty = 1, reset pointers by the handshake, and signal o_sw_rst_busy until both reset FSMs are back in RUN, read side first.
A write must store the data, increment the write pointer and register its Gray value, queuing the word.
A read must increment the read pointer and register its Gray value; o_rd_data then shows the next word with no extra latency (show-ahead).
The write must be rejected and o_overflow must pulse for one cycle in the cycle after the request.
The read must be rejected and o_underflow must pulse for one cycle in the cycle after the request.

rules.condition: i_rst_n_sw = 0 and write FSM in RUN
rules.statement: Software reset must run a four-phase handshake (block, reset read pointer, acknowledge, reset write pointer, release read side, release write side), leaving the FIFO empty with both pointers 0 and flags normal.

rules.condition: After a source pointer register changes, with S synchronizer stages
rules.statement: A destination-domain flag, combinational from the synchronized pointer, must reflect a source pointer update after destination edge S.
The flag must change after destination edge S, S+1, or S+2.

rules.condition: While the pointer crossing is in progress
rules.statement: Flags must be pessimistic in between: never report not-full or not-empty prematurely.
The write pointer Gray register must update at the same edge as the storage write, and an entry must be rewritten only after the write domain has seen the read pointer pass it.
The storage output register must capture the word on every read-clock edge.

rules.condition: After a write, with nominal synchronizer stages
rules.statement: o_empty must not fall earlier than the second read-clock edge after the write; minimum latency is S >= 2 edges, also for the model.

rules.condition: At the edge where o_empty falls
rules.statement: The word must be clean, with the storage-to-output-register path shorter than one read-clock period.
A valid word must never be read while it is being written.

rules.condition: A read of an address being written while o_empty = 1
rules.statement: The value read must not be used because o_empty = 1; the macro model returns the old word.
Reads must not be accepted before a write (o_empty = 1); o_rd_data may be undefined while the entry at the read pointer was never written.

rules.condition: Real macro read of an address being written while empty
rules.statement: A real macro may return an unknown value.
The macro wrapper must present show-ahead behavior, with a synchronous storage read using the next-pointer address.
